name: these days
source:
You are depressed. Not as in 'sad,' but as in clinically diagnosed with a mood disorder. Choose everything on one day, from what to do first thing in the morning to what to eat, and remember no action is free of consequence. Navigate the delicate balance between energy and activity and try to get youself closer out of the rut. 

[From [url=https://orangedaisy.itch.io/thesedays]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你患有抑郁症。这不只是“难过”，而是经临床确诊的情绪障碍。一天里，从早晨醒来先做什么，到吃些什么，一切都由你选择。请记住，任何行动都会带来影响。小心维持精力与活动之间的平衡，试着让自己离走出困境更近一步。

[摘自[url=https://orangedaisy.itch.io/thesedays]itch.io[/url]]
